verifiedObservedFacts.fact: After the Android fullscreen notice was dismissed with a normal tap, the visible New Game flow opened the narrative screen titled The Audition, visible Next controls advanced the flow, and the captured run reached a live dungeon map with the player marker, Health: 50, Inventory and action controls visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves actual gameplay entry only for the captured validation window and does not infer hidden quest, combat, loot or progression rules.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: In the live dungeon, the captured gameplay input changed the player marker position to the right between the before and after frames while remaining on the same gameplay map.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the directly visible movement response is promoted; movement cost, pathfinding, turn timing and collision rules are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The package remained alive and foreground after onboarding and gameplay input, and the captured log window contained no FATAL EXCEPTION, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV or ANR marker for the target package.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This establishes stability only for the captured black-box validation window.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A story or dialogue sequence after New Game is still a pre-game state; live gameplay entry should be recorded only once the interactive world and player state are visible.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox RPG QA, keep narrative onboarding and first controllable world entry as separate milestones.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The verified gameplay view keeps the world map, player marker, health readout, inventory access and primary action controls visible together, reducing context switching during basic play.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For a Roblox RPG, keep essential player state and high-frequency actions legible around the core world view without copying this game's visual design.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A bounded gameplay input produced an immediate visible player-position change in the same world view.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For mobile Roblox RPG movement, bind successful input to prompt and unambiguous world-state feedback, then validate it with semantic before and after frames.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Run 58 reached the narrative onboarding screen but missed the visible Next control, so lack of game entry there was an automation-targeting failure rather than evidence that gameplay could not be entered. Run 59 corrected only that visible-control targeting and reached live gameplay.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: When a clearly visible onboarding control is the only observed blocker, allow one minimal coordinate correction before abandoning the target; do not lower the game-entry criterion.
